A.P.P -----------
rd 2/Dated:23 March, 2023 I.A. No.2296 of 2023 This interlocutory application has been filed under section 389(1) of the Cr. P.C for suspension of sentence passed in consequence of the judgment of conviction dated 19.12.2022 and order of sentence dated 05.01.2023 in S.T. No.457 of 2018 by learned Additional Sessions Judge-X, Dhanbad, whereby and whereunder the appellant has been convicted under Section 376(D) of the Indian Penal Code and directed to undergo rigorous imprisonment 20 years and to pay fine of Rs.20,000/- for the said offence and in default of payment of fine he shall undergo additional sentence for six months.

It has been contended on behalf of the appellant that the testimony of the victim and the other related witness is not being corroborated from the testimony of doctor regarding commission of rape as would appear from the discussion so made by the learned trial court in the impugned judgment at paragraph 14 thereof.

Learned counsel appearing for the appellant on the aforesaid ground has submitted that since the commission of rape has not been corroborated by the medical expert, therefore, it is a fit case where the sentence is to be kept in abeyance.

This Court after having heard learned counsel for the appellant, is hereby calling upon the State to file objection as to why the sentence in connection with S.T. No.457 of 2018 by learned Additional Ghaltu Mahato @ Ghaltu @ Sagar Mahato vs The State Of Jharkhand on 23 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/122505207/
1 Sessions Judge- X, Dhanbad be not kept in abeyance.
